prior_schema_precheck.reason: Recognize 2481 official pr_<number> IDs as pr_mined before environmental/model outcomes; old precheck retained.

rules.environment_replacement: Only before the first model run: preserve rejected repositories/reasons and use next repository in the predeclared order. No task substitution after model outcomes; unknowns remain in the fixed denominator.
rules.exact_duplicate: Same repository and ordered changed file/addition/deletion content after whitespace normalization; diff metadata, hunk offsets and context omitted.
rules.near_duplicate: Same repository and F2P-set Jaccard >= 0.8, plus either shared changed function contexts or >= 0.8 overlap of the smaller changed-old-line set. Same normalized patch is always a duplicate. This mechanical heuristic does not certify semantic independence.
rules.repeat_allocation: 2 per selected repository; different mutation families when available, then ascending SHA256(repeat_seed, task_id). Fixed before model outcomes.
rules.within_repository: Round robin over mutation families ordered by seeded SHA256; within each family prefer previously unused changed functions, then files, then seeded SHA256. Reject exact and near duplicates against already selected tasks.
